# UElement Technologies

> UElement Technologies Private Limited is a DeepTech company in Wakad, Pune, India, serving customers in the Americas, the UK and Europe, the Middle East and Africa, and JAPAC. It has two product lines: UElement Quantum (quantum-safe security for banks, insurers, NBFCs, fintechs and critical infrastructure) and MainSTAY (an enterprise platform family whose first product, Nexus, runs websites, portals and workflows). Tagline: Sovereign DeepTech for the systems that cannot fail.

UElement labels every product by maturity and changes a label only when the status changes. Status as of 1 October 2026:

- UElement Quantum Discovery (CBOM and quantum readiness assessment): early access.
- UElement Quantum PQC (migration to NIST FIPS 203/204/205, hybrid X25519MLKEM768): proof-of-concept with BFSI design partners.
- UElement Quantum Crypto-Agility (Axis, Codex, Crucible): in development.
- UElement Quantum QKD: planned for 2027, delivered with hardware partners.
- UElement Quantum Networking: research, not a product.
- UElement Quantum QML (quantum machine learning): research, not a product.
- MainSTAY Nexus (the enterprise digital fabric): in production with paying customers. Packages from USD 2,500.
- MainSTAY Vizor (observability, security, GRC for IT and OT): design partners, 45-day proof of value.
- MainSTAY Kayak (everything as a service for physical assets): roadmap, no deployments.

UElement does not describe any system as quantum-proof. As of October 2026 RBI has formed an expert committee on quantum security but set no binding PQC deadline; India's DST Task Force sets milestones of 2027/2028/2029 for critical infrastructure and 2028/2030/2033 for enterprises.
